title: WMS-specific Warehouse Extension
description: Namespaced sidecar for lossless WMS export/import roundtrips. Only record payloads are intentionally open.

namespace.description: Stable reverse-domain namespace owned by the WMS/vendor.

entity_type.description: Any entity type the compiler emits for this building (a key of the compiled artifact's entities, e.g. storage_point, bay, shelf, route_aisle). Not a fixed list: tools/validate.py checks it against the compiler's output, so a new entity kind is extensible without changing this schema.

payload.description: Opaque vendor-owned data preserved losslessly by generic tooling.
